title: Broadway / Pool+Balcony / Corner Unit / 2 King Bed
description:
2BR/2BA condo just 3 blocks (5-minute walk) from Broadway. Walk to Ryman Auditorium, Bridgestone Arena, the Country Music Hall of Fame. Perfect for families, groups, and business travelers seeking comfort, convenience, and a prime location.

★ 2 king beds + additional beds w/ two queen size convertible couches
★ Saltwater Pool and 24/7 Gym
★ Gated + covered parking (extra)
★ Balcony for fresh air
🔒 After-Hours Security Staff from 11PM-7AM (front desk help during regular business hours)

The space
With an open-concept living and dining area, it’s perfect for relaxing after a day of honky-tonk hopping or reconnecting with friends and family.

🛏️ Bedrooms:
**Master Bedroom: A luxurious retreat with a KING bed, TV, en-suite bathroom, and a walk-in closet with makeup vanity.

**Guest Bedroom: Cozy and functional with a KING bed and walk-in closet.

🚽 Bathrooms:
**Master En-Suite Bathroom: Features a sleek walk-in shower and modern double vanity.

**Guest Bathroom: Offers a spacious shower/tub combo.

👩‍🍳 Fully Equipped Kitchen:
Stove, oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, toaster, Keurig Coffee machine, and a bar with 4 seats.

😍 Amenities You'll Love:
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi
- Smart TV with streaming apps; Sonos music system
- Private balcony with a view facing Music City Center
- Sky lounge access with Pool and Poker table
- Rooftop pool area has fire pits, grills, and plenty of dining space 
- In-unit washer and dryer

🚗 Parking:
Dedicated parking space available in a gated garage

🤠 Prime Location – Walk Everywhere!
Stay just steps from Nashville’s most iconic destinations:

📍 Broadway- 10 min walk
📍 Bridgestone Arena- 8 min walk
📍 Music City Center- 6 min walk
📍 Country Music Hall of Fame- 4 min walk
📍 The Ryman Auditorium- 10 min walk
📍 The Gulch (0.5 miles) (or quick rideshare)
📍 Ascend Amphitheater- 0.6 mi (or quick rideshare)
📍 Nissan Stadium- 1.4 mi (or quick rideshare)

Guest access
**Resort-Style Amenities in a Prime Nashville Location**

Not only will you enjoy a stylish, comfortable retreat equipped with everything you need, but you'll also have access to additional amenities:

- Co-Working Space for productivity on the go
- Controlled Building Access for your safety and peace of mind
- 24-Hour Emergency Maintenance to ensure a hassle-free stay

*Early checkin or late checkout is available at an additional fee *based on availability*

**Special Reservations**
Need extra space for a group gathering or event? Guests can reserve the community spaces.

Other things to note
**Please note:** Quiet Hours,  you may see Pets on property but we do not allow pets, No smoking.
